lead: Shakira is best known as a Spanish singer, born on 2 February 1977 in Barranquilla.
As of 2026, she is 49 years old, and her birth date places her under the Aquarius sign.
She has 60 credited works on public record and has held the office of UNICEF Goodwill Ambassador.

sections.heading: Shakira — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Shakira was born on 2 February 1977 in Barranquilla, and holds Spanish and Colombian nationality. She was given the name Shakira Isabel Mebarak Ripoll at birth and is publicly known as Shakira.
Public records name her father, William Mebarak Chadid.
She is recorded as speaking Spanish, English, Italian and Portuguese.

sections.heading: Shakira — Career and Professional Work
paras: Shakira works primarily as a singer, actor, choreographer, guitarist, composer and philanthropist, with Epic Records, Sony Music and PepsiCo listed among her employers.
She has held the following offices: UNICEF Goodwill Ambassador (2003–present).
She performs on guitar, harmonica, percussion instrument and voice.
She has taken part in Viña del Mar International Song Festival, VH1 Divas, 49th Annual Grammy Awards, We Are One: The Obama Inaugural Celebration at the Lincoln Memorial and Rock in Rio.
